style: Rounded 2.5D UI icons in burgundy, rose pink and warm ivory
delivery: Generated transparent PNG masters are preserved here; 256px alpha-preserving delivery copies are in public/assets/ipa.

assets.name: home
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one production mobile bottom-navigation icon for the IPA burgundy website. Remake the supplied existing raster icon in a unified premium rounded 2.5D cartoon UI style. Keep the simple, immediately readable symbol of the subject, rendered at a front or extremely slight three-quarter view. Warm ivory ceramic highlights, muted rose-pink body, burgundy #681C32 accents, smooth dark plum contour edges. Rounded bevels, restrained soft glossy highlights, compact self-shadow, no excessive sparkle or floating props. Match the same visual family as the original controller/gift/trophy/avatar icons, but cleaner and more dimensional. Square canvas, exactly one centered isolated icon occupying 78-84% of the width and height, balanced consistent weight, generous even transparent padding. The image must remain very legible when displayed at 48px. Genuine transparent background with alpha, no background color, no checkerboard, no ground plane. No words, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no surrounding tile or badge.
Subject: a cute rounded game controller, ivory upper body, rose grips, burgundy directional plus pad on the left and two small burgundy action buttons on the right. Keep its recognizable compact controller silhouette. No wire.
